I attached a marked-up copy (I can't attach a file in this reply through Gmail export, but redline notes are inlined below). We also have a procurement lead who will join if you want to fast-track PrivateOffer sign-off.

Inline notes:
- Intro paragraph: change "replace" -> "augment"
- Benefits bullet 3: drop explicit uptime percentage
- Data usage line: rephrase to "opt-in telemetry with customer consent"

Next steps from our side: I can get procurement to sign the SKU mapping tomorrow morning and start the PrivateOffer paperwork if you confirm the final pitchline text.

Best,

- "Cost predictable: dedicated and burst options to control inference economics at scale."
- "Compliance-ready: VPC and private deployment options with KMS integrations for regulated workloads."

Kimberly — legal note: I removed the uptime percentage and replaced the data usage line with Sarah's suggested phrasing.
